name: reviews
description: Same-vendor and cross-vendor evidence-grounded multi-model review for code, architecture, and technical documents: execution-gated, identity-blinded, refutation-asymmetric.

interface.shortDescription: Review code and documents with two AI models, then cross-examine the findings
interface.longDescription: cross-review and pair-review run two reviewers on the same target, exchange their findings with identities hidden, and settle each finding with a fresh auditor. They produce findings.json, a scorecard and a manifest. A review run from a Codex host is not supported in 1.1.0; run the skills from Claude Code.
